description: Minimal capability set for the main window. Grants core Tauri primitives, notification:default (one aggregate 'N new messages' OS notification after a background/manual sync; counts only, never subjects or senders), and a single scoped opener permission: opener:allow-open-url restricted to `https://*`, used to launch the OAuth2 consent screen in the system browser (RFC 8252 external agent). No path opening (open_path), no reveal-in-dir, no mailto/tel/http scheme, and no shell, filesystem, or arbitrary-network permissions.
